about: Original scaled Topic 1 practice; preliminary curriculum levels verified separately.

types.name: Subtract and divide signals in standard form

unknowns.asked: Subtract and divide signals in standard form

constraints: Align unlike powers before subtraction, then renormalise an independent quotient. Exact small terminating mantissas make the algebra appropriate without technology.

types.name: Recover a length from a standard-form area

unknowns.asked: Recover a length from a standard-form area

constraints: Take a root across coefficient and power, then convert units and aggregate lengths. The displayed area is a positive exact square.

types.name: Recover arithmetic terms from two block sums

unknowns.asked: Recover arithmetic terms from two block sums

constraints: Compare corresponding terms in disjoint equal-length blocks and reconstruct the first term. The blocks give unique independent constraints.

types.name: Find an omitted partial sum of an arithmetic sequence

unknowns.asked: Find an omitted partial sum of an arithmetic sequence

constraints: Infer the common difference from nonconsecutive terms and reconstruct an earlier endpoint before summing.

types.name: Recover a negative geometric ratio across an odd gap

unknowns.asked: Recover a negative geometric ratio across an odd gap

constraints: An odd term gap uniquely determines the sign and magnitude of the ratio. Rebuild an earlier initial term before finding the sum.

types.name: Extract geometric terms from three partial totals

unknowns.asked: Extract geometric terms from three partial totals

constraints: Partial totals are not terms; use successive differences to obtain the ratio and a new partial total.

types.name: Solve an index equation with a reciprocal

unknowns.asked: Solve an index equation with a reciprocal

constraints: Combine positive and negative powers, establish the zero exponent, then translate a reciprocal into logarithmic notation.

types.name: Solve a log equation and reject the inadmissible root

unknowns.asked: Solve a log equation and reject the inadmissible root

constraints: Both arguments must be positive. Their product creates a two-root quadratic, but only one candidate is legal in the log equation.

types.name: Reconcile a reciprocal power with a rational power

unknowns.asked: Reconcile a reciprocal power with a rational power

constraints: Recover the exact common root, reconstruct the base and apply the reciprocal exponent without decimalising.

types.name: Convert a two-digit repeating tail into an exact fraction

unknowns.asked: Convert a two-digit repeating tail into an exact fraction

constraints: Separate the non-repeating prefix and model the repeating tail as an infinite geometric sequence.

types.name: Find a signed remainder in an alternating geometric series

unknowns.asked: Find a signed remainder in an alternating geometric series

constraints: Justify convergence and retain the sign of the remaining tail. Parameters keep the ratio within the open unit interval.

types.name: Recover a binomial index from adjacent coefficient ratios

unknowns.asked: Recover a binomial index from adjacent coefficient ratios

constraints: Simplify a ratio of adjacent binomial coefficients to identify the unknown exponent; then find the requested coefficient.

types.name: Cancel a product’s linear term and find its quadratic coefficient

unknowns.asked: Cancel a product’s linear term and find its quadratic coefficient

constraints: Combine contributions to the linear coefficient to find the multiplier, then combine different term pairs for the quadratic coefficient.

types.name: Use an identity to prove divisibility of a gap of squares

unknowns.asked: Use an identity to prove divisibility of a gap of squares

constraints: Numerical preparation supports a general identity and divisibility argument. The proof is independently checked by polynomial coefficients, but the learner self-marks reasoning.

types.name: Combine measurements with different powers of ten

unknowns.asked: Combine measurements with different powers of ten

constraints: Align scales, keep unrounded totals and round each technology-assisted final value in standard form.

types.name: Compare the crossover of two increasing pay schedules

unknowns.asked: Compare the crossover of two increasing pay schedules

constraints: Compare two different finite arithmetic sums, then use a numeric table to locate the first whole week with a positive difference. Whole-week answers are intentional.

types.name: Infer a decay factor from sensor measurements and find a threshold time

unknowns.asked: Infer a decay factor from sensor measurements and find a threshold time

constraints: Infer a non-integer decay multiplier from two observations, then use it without premature rounding to locate a strict threshold.

types.name: Compare annual and monthly compounding over the same period

unknowns.asked: Compare annual and monthly compounding over the same period

constraints: Use different compounding frequencies and compare near balances in currency. Keep unrounded values until the requested cents.

types.name: Recover a nominal annual rate from a target balance

unknowns.asked: Recover a nominal annual rate from a target balance

constraints: Invert monthly compounding for an awkward multiplier, then convert the unrounded value into a nominal annual rate.

types.name: Separate nominal interest from real purchasing power

unknowns.asked: Separate nominal interest from real purchasing power

constraints: Apply independent growth and inflation processes, distinguish nominal euros from constant-price euros, and report a signed percentage change.

types.name: Reverse depreciation and a resale commission

unknowns.asked: Reverse depreciation and a resale commission

constraints: Undo the one-time percentage fee then reverse compounded depreciation across several years.

types.name: Combine intensities before applying a logarithmic scale

unknowns.asked: Combine intensities before applying a logarithmic scale

constraints: Add intensity ratios before the logarithm and compare levels. This explicitly distinguishes intensity space and level space.

types.name: Solve a shifted exponential quadratic and round at the end

unknowns.asked: Solve a shifted exponential quadratic and round at the end

constraints: Use a hidden quadratic substitution, enforce the positive branch, and recover a noninteger exponent with logarithms.

types.name: Recover an infinite sum from two measured partial sums

unknowns.asked: Recover an infinite sum from two measured partial sums

constraints: Use the difference of consecutive partial sums to predict the next term, then estimate an entire remaining tail without rounding twice.
